contents.text: {"answer":"The existing decision treats recall 24V064000 as related but describing a different failure: you reported that no airbags deployed during either impact, while the recall concerns a front passenger seat weight sensor failing to suppress the airbag, potentially causing unintended deployment. The recall includes the 2022 Acura MDX, but that model overlap does not establish that it addresses the reported nondeployment.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"complaint","id":"11633527","quote":"Zero  airbags were deployed with either impact."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V064000","quote":"The front passenger seat weight sensor may crack and short circuit, failing to suppress the air bag as intended."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V064000","quote":"An air bag that deploys unintentionally during a crash can increase the risk of injury."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V064000","quote":"2022 Acura MDX"}]}
